newsitem.title: UK: UK's EasyJet's 300 mln stg Boeing 737 order.
newsitem.headline: UK's EasyJet's 300 mln stg Boeing 737 order.

text.p: Low-cost UK airline EasyJet has placed a 300 million stg order for 12 new 737 aircraft from U.S. manufacturer Boeing Co.

EasyJet said in a statement on Friday the first six 'planes would be delivered in 1998, with the remainder due in 1999. The expansion will allow EasyJet to add a number of new destinations including Geneva, Oslo, Belfast and Madrid.

The UK airline said its order for the Boeing 737-300 jets would allow it to triple its passenger numbers to six million by the year 2000. The news comes just one month after the airline stranded holidaymakers due to a shortage of planes.

EasyJet currently has five 737 aircraft with a sixth due in November this year. It operates services across the UK and the Continent, providing a no-frills service with fares starting at 29 stg to Scotland and 49 stg to continental Europe.
